articles.title: 'Psyren' Announces Additional Cast Pair
articles.summary: The official X (formerly Twitter) account for the television anime adaptation of Toshiaki Iwashiro's Psyren manga announced a pair of additional cast on Thursday. The anime series premiered on October 5 at 11.00 p.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by BS11 and Sun TV. Voice actors Reiko Suzuki (Versailles no Bara) and Ayumu Murase (Chainsaw Man) are joining the cast as Elmore Tenjuin and Van Tenjuin, respectively. Katsumi Ono (Gaikotsu Kishi-sama, Tadaima Isekai e Odekakechuu) is directing the anime.
